title: 2012 SAGE Hit #25 Ryan Broyles Oklahoma Sooners Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 SAGE Hit sports trading card features Ryan Broyles, a talented football player from the Oklahoma Sooners team. The card is part of the base set and is a rookie card, making it a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection. The card number is 25 and it is manufactured by SAGE. 

The card is ideal for fans of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and collectors of sports trading cards. It is a great way to commemorate the 2012 season and Ryan Broyles' achievements. This item is perfect for anyone who loves sports and wants to add a unique piece to their collection.
